priorityList: Maintain Eradicate: Use Void Ray in AoE if the Eradicate buff is not currently active.
Cooldown Window: Cast Metamorphosis while the Eradicate buff is active.
Burst Synchronization: Use Trinkets, Potions, and external buffs (like Power Infusion) specifically during Metamorphosis.
Max Stack Burst: Use Voidblade followed by The Hunt when at maximum Void Metamorphosis stacks (with Devourer's Bite and Voidsurge talented).
Soul Consumption: Execute your 'Reaps' rotation (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) if you have 4+ souls, or during Metamorphosis to maintain Voidfall or Eradicate buffs.
Star Preparation: Use Pierce the Veil when Moment of Craving is active and Collapsing Star is ready.
Voidblade Stacking: Use Voidblade if Moment of Craving is active and you are near maximum Collapsing Star stacks.
Collapsing Star: Use Collapsing Star when builders like Voidblade and Predators Wake are on cooldown, or at high stacks.
Soul Immolation: Keep Soul Immolation active in AoE, but only cast it when you are NOT in Metamorphosis.
Voidstep Mobility: Use Vengeful Retreat when the Voidstep buff is active to manage resources.
Primary AoE: Use Hungering Slash and Reapers Toll as your main priority buttons in multi-target combat.
Priority Builder: Cast Pierce the Veil as a priority generator when specialized for Devourer's Bite or AoE cleave.
Predators Wake: Use Predators Wake on cooldown to maximize throughput.
Meta Filler: Use Voidblade during Metamorphosis if higher priority builders are unavailable.
Low Priority Fillers: Use Devour and Consume as final buttons to fill any empty GCDs.
